description: Joint application for formation of a vehicle access to each house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location Plan Drawing 1, Block Plan Drawing 2, and Drawing 3 - 211 Front Garden Sketch, received: 30/07/2019. Unnumbered 209 Front Garden Sketch received: 14/09/2019. Unnumbered 209 & 211 General Area Plan, received: 23/09/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the proposed accesses, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access. No fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays at either application property. The splays shall be implemented prior to first use of the accesses and maintained at all times thereafter.

Condition : 4 - The retained front boundary walls shown on the approved plans shall be erected in brickwork before the use of the crossover commences, they shall not exceed 600 mm in height and shall be retained as such for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 5 - The hard surfaces created shall be made of porous materials which ensure that run-off water is managed within the curtilage of each application property, and prevented from entering the public drainage system. This shall be maintained at all times thereafter.
